linked_list.python:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.next = None

head = Node(10)
head.next = Node(20)
head.next.next = Node(30)
cur = head
while cur:
    print(cur.data, end=' -> ' if cur.next else '')
    cur = cur.next
